_comment: Ground truth for M3 recall scoring. Each defect is a KNOWN planted flaw. A voice's finding counts as detecting a defect iff it matches the defect's detection_key by (file basename, category exact, line within line_tolerance). See docs/benchmark-protocol.md for the match rule and metric definitions. cheapest_capable_layer ties to the assurance pyramid ordering in docs/self-measurement.md (M2); it records the cheapest layer whose method could in principle catch this defect, used later for routing analysis, not for recall.

defects.description: loop bound uses <= where < is required, writes one past the buffer
u32 addition can overflow on adversarial input
a rare interleaving leaves the accumulator inconsistent with the index; only a model checker over the full transition relation finds it
public entry point indexes a slice without validating the caller-supplied offset
documented default differs from the coded default
